entries.title: Is NFC charging the secret to nicer-looking smartglasses?
entries.summary: A pair of prototype Ray Ban Meta glasses at AWE 2026 show that NFC charging can achieve similar performance to the pogo pins common in smart glasses today.
entries.excerpt: If you've been testing and writing about smartglasses for as long as I have then you're used to a lot of questions along the lines of "why do they look like that?" Though smartgasses have come a long way in the last few years, most frames are still significantly thicker than the eyewear most people are used to wearing.
